test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

Why has the Chief Minister sealed the Delhi borders?

options.text: Why are the Delhi borders being sealed by the Chief Minister?
Why have the Delhi borders been sealed by the Chief Minister?
Why the Chief Minister has been sealed by the Delhi borders?
Why were the Delhi borders sealed by the Chief Minister?

solution:
The correct answer is **'Why have the Delhi borders been sealed by the Chief Minister?'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• In 'active-passive' transformation except for (who and whom) rest of the Wh-family Pronouns will remain unchanged. 
 
• Here, in the given question 'Why' will remain unchanged.
 
• The **subject** of the given sentence is **'the Chief Minister' **and the object of the given sentence is **'the Delhi borders'.**
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• As we know that **'the Delhi borders'** is plural hence** 'have'** will be used.
 
• 'has sealed' will be changed into 'have been sealed'. 
 
• Lastly, the preposition 'by' will be added. 

 
 
 

Correct Sentence:__ *Why have the Delhi borders been sealed by the Chief Minister?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Active Voice का उदाहरण है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Passive Voice में बदलना है।
 
• परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• 'Active-Passive' परिवर्तन में (who और whom) को छोड़कर शेष Wh- परिवार pronouns अपरिवर्तित रहेंगे।
 
• यहां, दिए गए प्रश्न में 'Why' अपरिवर्तित रहेंगी ।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य का **Subject** **'the Chief Minister'** है। और दिए गए वाक्य का **Object 'the Delhi borders' **है।
 
• **Object** के स्थान पर **Subject** रखा जाएगा और **Subject** के स्थान पर **Object** रखी जाएगी।
 
• जैसा कि हम जानते हैं कि 'the Delhi borders' plural है इसलिए '**have**' का प्रयोग किया जाएगा।
 
• **'has sealed' **को** 'have been sealed' **में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• अंत में, preposition 'by' जोड़ा जाएगा।
